The whole import is built but none of it is on main yet. The upload report, column mapping and dry-run commit sit on the `csv-import` branch, 158 lines with tests, waiting for your ruling. Main still holds only the old export. On saved views, the filter value is built and merged into its branch. Saving and sharing are stuck behind the storage research and your pick of list shape.

## next

- **csv-import**: one ruling puts the import on main. Answer commit-the-import's D1 (should the dry run name the entry each skipped row matched?) in the same sitting.
- **flaky-export-test**: the fix is already built on its branch. Before you answer D1, note that retire-the-legacy-exporter would delete `export_csv`, the very function that file test covers.
- **view-list-shape**: the three takes are rendered in `agent/show/view-list-shape/three-takes.html`. Your pick unblocks save-and-reopen-a-view.

All three can run at the same time. None touches another's files.
